# govern-project-docs

> An open-source Codex Skill and zero-dependency Node.js toolkit for keeping repository documentation authoritative, searchable, and economical for humans and AI agents to read.

## Primary links

- Project site: https://ch-zhou-0512.github.io/govern-project-docs/
- Source repository: https://github.com/CH-ZHOU-0512/govern-project-docs
- Documentation: https://github.com/CH-ZHOU-0512/govern-project-docs/wiki
- Getting started: https://github.com/CH-ZHOU-0512/govern-project-docs/wiki/Getting-Started
- Discussions: https://github.com/CH-ZHOU-0512/govern-project-docs/discussions

## Project facts

- Author: CH-ZHOU-0512
- License: MIT
- Runtime: Node.js 22 or 24
- Runtime dependencies: none
- Supported CI platforms: Ubuntu and Windows
- Core workflow: audit, govern, enforce

## Capabilities

- Read-only documentation audits
- Deterministic document index generation and bounded querying
- Documentation governance policy checks
- Local Markdown link validation
- Cross-platform file watching for local feedback
